heading: Remove Text from Video Online with AI
intro:
A saved video can become hard to reuse when an old price, a burned-in caption, a timestamp, or a campaign message is baked into the frames. WatermarkGemini lets you test AI-assisted cleanup for visible text that stays in one fixed screen area. Keep your original framing, review the credit cost, and check the repaired video before downloading. If the text is still an editable layer or a separate subtitle track, remove that layer first instead of reconstructing pixels.

Illustrative use cases only, not actual tested product results; replace with rights-cleared real outputs when tested. For full-motion examples, show matching video frames, not a claim of perfect clip-wide recovery.

features.heading: A Video Text Remover Designed for Reusable Footage
features.intro: From old ad copy to captions burned into finished videos, the priority is removing what is no longer useful while keeping the original content and context readable.

items.heading: Remove Old Prices and Campaign Text from Product Videos
items.description: A once-useful “20% OFF” overlay can become misleading after a promotion ends. For your own product footage, a fixed-region video cleanup can help clear an outdated price or temporary label so the scene can be edited again. Never remove mandatory safety disclosures, ingredient information or required product claims. Inspect the repaired area carefully when packaging, hands or reflections pass behind the words.
items.imageAlt: Illustrative remove text from video use case 1: remove old prices and campaign text from product videos, showing one matched scene without cropping or missing subjects.

items.heading: Clean Burned-In Subtitles and Lower Thirds
items.description: Hardcoded subtitles are part of the rendered picture, unlike SRT files or switchable caption tracks. When captions stay within a stable lower-third band, a fixed selection may remove their visible pixels. This can help prepare an authorized interview or tutorial for new language captions. Results are less reliable when animated subtitles cross faces, text changes position, or captions overlap moving subjects.
items.imageAlt: Illustrative remove text from video use case 2: clean burned-in subtitles and lower thirds, showing one matched scene without cropping or missing subjects.

items.heading: Keep the Full Frame Instead of Blurring or Cropping
items.description: Cropping out a lower-third label can cut off gestures, product details or subtitles you plan to add later. A targeted repair preserves more of the 9:16 or 16:9 composition. AI fills an estimated background where lettering once appeared; it does not retrieve exact original footage. Compare hard edges and fine texture at real playback speed, especially in social clips.
items.imageAlt: Illustrative remove text from video use case 3: keep the full frame instead of blurring or cropping, showing one matched scene without cropping or missing subjects.

items.heading: Online Text Cleanup with Clear Limits
items.description: Choose a local MP4, use the video workspace, sign in and review its quoted cost. Current input requires MP4 at 24 fps, up to 9 minutes and 100 MB; no video trial is promised from free image uses. You can try fixed-area or automatic watermark detection, not a guaranteed dedicated OCR/subtitle-tracking mode. Uploaded media and returned files use temporary private storage scheduled to expire after about 24 hours.

faq.heading: Remove Text from Video FAQs
faq.intro: Understand the difference between burned-in and removable subtitle tracks, free-use rules, fixed text limits and export quality.

items.question: How do I remove text from a video?
items.answer: Check whether the text is an editable project layer, a separate subtitle track, or pixels baked into the file. Delete editable layers first. For a compatible authorized MP4 with fixed embedded text, choose WatermarkGemini’s video workspace, mark the region, review the credits and process a test.

items.question: Can I remove text from video online for free?
items.answer: The online tool offers a browser workflow, but video processing is not covered by WatermarkGemini’s free image uses. Video jobs require processing credits allocated by an administrator. Review the exact quote and balance before running the task.

items.question: Can AI remove text from a video without blur?
items.answer: AI-assisted reconstruction attempts to rebuild the background rather than cover letters with a blur bar. It can still leave smudges or flicker, particularly on patterns, faces, hands or moving products. Compare multiple frames before downloading.

items.question: What is the difference between burned-in subtitles and soft subtitles?
items.answer: Burned-in subtitles are visible pixels in the video and cannot be turned off in a player. Soft subtitles exist as a separate track or file, often SRT or embedded captions. Disable or edit the soft track directly; an AI text remover is unnecessary for that case.

items.question: Can I remove subtitles from an MP4 video?
items.answer: If subtitle text is permanently embedded and stays in a stable screen band, you may test the fixed-area video cleanup. The site’s separate subtitle-removal page has been marked as planned, so do not assume full automatic caption tracking is supported.

items.question: Can it erase moving or animated text?
items.answer: The current fixed-area control remains at the same coordinates throughout the clip; it does not follow moving text. Scrolling titles, karaoke captions or text attached to moving subjects are better handled in the original project or a motion-tracking editor.

items.question: How do I remove a timestamp from video?
items.answer: If the timestamp was added by a camera or editor as a fixed burned-in corner label, make a backup and test a narrow fixed-area selection. If it is only a player display, disable that display without touching video pixels.

items.question: Which video files does the text remover support?
items.answer: The existing video workspace accepts one MP4 at 24 fps, up to 9 minutes and 100 MB, after compatibility checks. MOV, AVI, URLs and batch processing are not currently part of this route.

items.question: Can I remove an old price from a product video?
items.answer: For footage you own, remove an editable price layer and re-export whenever possible. If the price is burned in, a small fixed box over a simple background may work. Keep all required packaging labels, disclaimers and other essential information.

items.question: Will the edited video keep its original sound?
items.answer: The processed file is returned as MP4. Open the download in another player and verify soundtrack, dialogue, synchronization and duration before publishing; quality should be checked on the final export, not inferred from the preview.

items.question: What if text removal damages a face or product detail?
items.answer: Stop using that fixed selection. Reduce the box if the words are small, return to the source project, replace the shot or choose an editor with temporal masking. AI cannot reconstruct an exact hidden face, logo or fine product lettering.
